currentDataContract.summary: MediaLibraryItem.chatArchive is optional/null or a typed object with state complete/partial/unknown. There is no none or unavailable summary enum. These values describe storage evidence, not a positive chat message count or a provider-wide guarantee.
currentDataContract.publication: platform_media.rs verify_publish inspects the exact owned job chat proof for video downloads. SOOP executes download_with_metadata only when the same official VOD plan declares show_chat=Y. That creates a writing marker and terminal complete/partial proof, then publishes the summary with independently verified video. Ordinary YouTube VOD and SOOP videos without chat have no proof and no summary.
currentDataContract.legacy: An absent/null summary does not prove no saved chat for older live recordings. Keep their existing replay pane and its truthful missing/empty/unmapped/ready states. Do not backfill, scan, migrate or fabricate summaries.
currentDataContract.partialOrUnknown: Retain the existing warning and allow the replay pane to read whatever actually survives. A pane with an explicit missing/empty/retry state is appropriate for a declared archive attempt, not a claim that messages exist or were completely preserved.

proposal.eligibility: Render existing replay chat when the opened playback item is a live recording OR has a non-null chatArchive summary. Read eligibility from the authoritative opened item, not a possibly stale library card. No provider-name heuristic, background archive probe or new backend API.
proposal.ui: Reuse existing chat geometry, bounded local replay API, video currentTime seek, privacy handling and close button beside chat controls. Without an eligible archive retain the current video-only close location and full width. No new explanatory text, controls, layout or playback lifecycle.

conflicts: The original live-only replay eligibility predates requested SOOP VOD chat support. Latest item2 supersedes that type-only assumption; it does not authorize a chat pane for every ordinary video.

The old completion contract says normal VOD downloads make no new chat claim. That remains true for ordinary VOD without a proof; the newer explicit SOOP timed-chat contract supplies a real summary for eligible VOD.
Do not restrict eligibility to state complete: doing so hides surviving partial chat and its warning. Do not infer chat from a title, provider, file duration or message count.
acceptance: SOOP kind-video playback with complete/partial/unknown summaries renders exactly one existing replay pane and calls the existing replay API with that opened library ID; partial/unknown warning remains visible.
Video items with absent/null summaries in both providers remain video-only and make no replay-chat read. Ordinary YouTube VOD behavior is unchanged.
Legacy live recordings without summaries retain their existing chat pane and honest missing state; no fabricated completion warning appears.
Actual opened-item summary wins over a stale list item's summary.
New SOOP VOD pane uses video position for seek, preserves one video and token on inactive tab, performs no hidden chat polling, hides content during privacy and keeps close/replay controls usable.
Existing library selection, overlays, background playback, replay-at-end and warning tests remain green. Focused frontend tests are not actual desktop proof.
